entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Yeah, yeah, just get me someone. I need to make a return.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Sarah. I can definitely help you with a return. Do you have your order number handy?
Order is VF88602. It's for some cycling shoes.
Got it, VF88602. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order was delivered about 59 days ago. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes?
Look, they don't work for me. They're causing bad blisters and I can never get the cleats set right. I just want my money back. Can you do it or not?
I understand. I'm just checking our policy for you now... And yes, absolutely. You're well within our 90-day return window for those cycling shoes.
Okay, so you're processing the refund?

Yes. I have just authorized the return. I've sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address on your account. Just pack the shoes in a box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, you'll see a full refund to your original payment method in 3-5 business days.
Great. That's all I needed. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can help with today?
